name: O In-jun (오인준)

attribution.legal_posture: Korea Daesong Bank representative and financial facilitator sanctioned by the United States and Republic of Korea; named by an issuing government or multilateral sanctions-monitoring source. The record carries an administrative sanctions designation; criminal charge and conviction require separate records.

caveats: Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; alias ownership and worker identity remain source-unresolved.

The official primary name O, In Chun and aliases O, In Jun and source-literal O, ln-chun are source-specific romanizations tied to one OFAC entity. Only designation-era Vladivostok city-and-country context is retained; present location and precise address require separate evidence.

sources.support: Treasury identifies O In Chun as a Russia-based representative of Korea Daesong Bank, reports that he worked to unfreeze funds for an unnamed bank subordinate to the Munitions Industry Department, and records his E.O. 13551 designation.
